findings.title: Advance payment exceeds the limit
findings.message: The advance payment is 40%, above the 20% limit.
findings.evidence_text: 00 Total 317,400.00 Supplier TIN: 105458053391 BIN: 000570541-0101 TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. Payment. 40% advance payable with the purchase order. 40% advance with the purchase order, balance 60% within 30 days of

documents.decision_summary: Reject recommended because: Advance payment exceeds the limit.
documents.expected_decision_rationale: Item E is priced below the maximum, but the terms state a 40% advance payment, which exceeds the 20% limit.
documents.policy_ambiguity: The payment section repeats the advance percentages inconsistently (40% advance followed by balance 60%). The source should be interpreted as requiring a 40% advance, which triggers rejection; if the duplicated wording were intended to mean a different payment schedule, it would need clarification.

findings.title: Line total does not agree with quantity and unit price
findings.message: Stated line total 322000.00 does not equal 50000 x 6.40 = 320000.00.
findings.evidence_text: ments Ltd (fictional) Reference PR-2026-114 Item Description Qty Unit Unit price (BDT) Amount (BDT) D Poly bag, 30 x 40 cm 50,000 piece 6.40 322,000.00 Subtotal 322,000.00 VAT 15% 48,300.00 Total 370,300.00 Supplier TIN: 109458093391 BIN: 000970941-01

documents.decision_summary: Human review recommended because: Payment days are unclear; Delivery days are unclear; Line total does not agree with quantity and unit price.
documents.expected_decision_rationale: Item D is below the maximum price at 6.40 BDT, but its payment term is a 30 to 90 day range, which is unclear/outside 30 to 60 days; delivery is stated as 4 weeks, so it needs conversion and human review; and the stated line total of 322,000.00 BDT does not equal 50,000 times 6.40 BDT, which equals 320,000.00 BDT.
documents.policy_ambiguity: The delivery term uses weeks while policy thresholds are in days. QUVI should not silently assume the conversion in a confirmed violation; the converted value needs human confirmation.

findings.evidence_text: ITIONS 1. Payment. 10% advance payable with the purchase order. Payment within 45 days of delivery. 2. Delivery. Delivery within 60 days of PO. 3. Delay. Late delivery penalty of 0.5% of order value per week. 4. Validity. This quotation is val

findings.title: VAT presentation is unclear
findings.message: VAT was not identified as separately shown at 15%.

documents.decision_summary: Reject recommended because: Delivery is later than 45 days.
documents.expected_decision_rationale: Item E is below the maximum price at 94.00 BDT, but delivery is promised in 60 days, which exceeds the 45-day reject limit. VAT is included in the total rather than separately shown at 15%, which is a review condition but subordinate to the reject finding.
documents.policy_ambiguity: The price is marked 'BDT, VAT included', so the separately shown 15% VAT rule cannot be evaluated against a standalone VAT line.
